title: Swap Lyric Rows
items: Translations now sit above romaji on the video; the arrow beside their buttons swaps them
Bug fixes and performance improvements

title: Fuller Pictures
items: Recommendations’ pictures fill their cards, with no black bars above and below

title: Small Fixes
items: Bug fixes and performance improvements

title: A Cleaner Look
items: Search results sit three across, and More Like This is in each song’s menu
Words you’ve typed but not searched yet dim the results below until you press Search
The player’s Lyrics, Romaji and Translations buttons are a quiet grey when on
On a phone, playlists give song titles more room, and Reorder Songs is in the playlist’s menu
A missing page or a list that won’t load says so plainly, with Retry

title: Small Fixes
items: Bug fixes and performance improvements

title: Smoother Pages
items: Pages slide and fade into each other, and Back returns to where you were
The app opens on your last songs instead of a blank screen
With your phone on its side, the player stays full screen
Minimizing the player keeps your search results

title: Smoother Starts
items: What’s New: this page
New songs are ready up to 3× faster
No more “Couldn’t reach Synbox” on your first song of the day. A “Starting Synbox” note shows while it wakes up
Shared translations show under every line in the lyrics reader
A translation you drag no longer covers the lyrics

title: Better Lyrics and Translations
items: Karaoke highlight follows the singer more closely
Short lines that finish each other’s sentence share one translation
More natural translations
Sung lines missing from the published lyrics now show
Lines sung in another language no longer get wrong lyrics
Videos that aren’t Japanese songs say so instead of failing
Tap the artist’s name for more of their songs
